lemma sun (x:C.label d): ∃ A : ℝ,∀ N p T,k ≤ N→Tested C d k N p T→ ‖ladd C b k N p d T x‖≤A:= by
    let L:= F; let v:= weightTag C d b x; let r:= 2*C.path.levels.clock.monitor k;let R:= L.coeffSize (L.scaled r v)
    refine ⟨outward C d k * C.S.a k^d*(2*R),fun N p T hk hT=>?_⟩
    let Y:= ladd C b k N p d T x; let a:= shrink C k N p; have ht : 0<a:= shrink_pos C h hk p;have hz:a⁻¹≤r:= shrink_min C h hk p
    have hQ : L.scaled a (T Y)=v:= poured h hr hk b T hT x
    have hB: T Y=L.scaled a⁻¹ v:= by have he:=L.scaled_inv (inv_ne_zero ht.ne') (T Y); rw [inv_inv,hQ] at he; exact he.symm
    have he : L.coeffSize (T Y) ≤ R:= by
       rw [hB]; unfold R Frame.coeffSize; have h' : 0<r:= (inv_pos.mpr ht).trans_le hz
       apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j _; rw [Frame.scaled_apply,Frame.scaled_apply,norm_mul,norm_mul,Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity),Complex.norm_real,Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]; gcongr
    refine (show ‖Y‖ ≤ L.coeffSize Y from (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Work.G08.size_nonneg L _)).2 (fun i=> Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _=> norm_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i))).trans ((reference_size C h hr hk p Y).trans ?_)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ((hT.cost C T Y).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he zero_le_two)) (mul_nonneg (zero_le_one.trans (outward_nn ..)) (pow_nonneg (C.S.a_pos _).le _))

proof_context.conclusion: The lift ladd preserves unit, conjugation and signed reflections (pure_start, purer, rider), and is bounded by outward * a_k^d * 2R independently of N, p.

lemma w_right (F:Extraction.Order)(h: (S).RealSpin)(b:ℝ)(hp:Poised P B H O J n z k L) :
    let Y:=wok C D k b aux L
    (∃ M:ℝ,F.late fun N p=> ‖Y.atCut (N,p)‖ ≤ M)∧F.late fun N p=>
       Y.atCut (N,p) ⟨0,Nat.succ_pos D⟩ ((S).unit 0)= C.book.scalar 0 ∧
       (∀ i x,Y.atCut (N,p) i ((S).conj h i x)=star (Y.atCut (N,p) i x))∧
       ∀ i s x,Y.atCut (N,p) i ((S).mirror h i s x)=C.book.mirrorGroup i s (Y.atCut (N,p) i x) :=by
    intro Y
    have he(i:Fin (D+1)): C.ref i ≤ k :=hp.early _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.isLt)
    let μ:= Next.Rank.Station.mag A b k
    have hh(i:Fin (D+1)) (x) :∃ M:ℝ,∀ l:ℕ×ℕ,k<l.1 → ‖Y.atCut l i x‖≤M:=by
       obtain ⟨w,hw⟩:= sun H (he i) μ (ladder C i x); refine ⟨w,fun l hl=>?_⟩; exact hw _ _ _ hl.le (hp.charts l.1 l.2 hl i).1
    choose S' ht ht' using fun i:Fin (D+1)=> many_clm (fun l:ℕ×ℕ=>k<l.1) (fun l=> Y.atCut l i) (hh i)
    have hz:F.late fun N _=>k<N:= by unfold Extraction.Order.late; exact Eventually.of_forall fun i=> F.mesh.cofinal.eventually (eventually_gt_atTop _)
    refine ⟨⟨∑ i,S' i,hz.mono fun i he=>he.mono fun j h=> (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _=> ht i)).2 fun y=> (ht' y (F.mesh j,F.per i) h).trans (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _=>ht i) (Finset.mem_univ _))⟩,?_⟩
    refine hz.mono fun i he'=>he'.mono fun j hk=> ?_
    let K:=F.mesh j; let β:= F.per i
    let d0:Fin (D+1):=⟨0,Nat.succ_pos D⟩
    refine ⟨?_,fun u x=> ?_,fun u s x=>?_⟩
    · change ladd C μ k K β 0 (L K β d0) (ladder C 0 ((S).unit 0))=_; rw [ladder_unit]; exact pure_start H (he d0) (Nat.le_of_lt hk) _ _ (hp.charts K β hk d0).1
    · change ladd C μ k K β _ _ (ladder C _ ((Cells.standard C).conj h _ _))= star _; rw [ladder_conj]; exact purer H (he u) (Nat.le_of_lt hk) _ _ (hp.charts K β hk u).1 _
    change ladd C μ k K β _ _ (ladder C _ ((Cells.standard C).mirror h _ _ _))=_; rw [ladder_spin];exact rider H (he u) (Nat.le_of_lt hk) _ _ (hp.charts K β hk u).1 (hp.charts K β hk u).2 s _

proof_context.conclusion: The lifts are bounded on cutoff tails and satisfy the unit, conjugation and signed laws.

structure Tested (d k N p : ℕ) (read : C.label d →ₗ[ℂ] C.label d) : Prop where
  unit : read (C.refUnit d) = (C.labels.level d).e0
  preserves v : read (star v) = star (read v)
  score v :
    let F := C.labels.level d; let a := awake C d k N p v
    F.coeffSize (a-read v) ≤ F.coeffSize a/2

proof_context.conclusion: The inverse estimate is iterated level by level (at_current), readouts with relative coefficient error at most 1/2 cost at most factor 2 to invert, and are bijective.
